errors.description: completion_data_q is a multi-bit value produced in pcie_clk and sampled directly in core_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
cpl_pulse_q is a one-cycle pcie_clk pulse consumed directly in core_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
cpl_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample core_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in core_event_o.
tag_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector tag_mode_q before decoding in core_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
pcie_rst_n is used as data inside core_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
cfg_snapshot_q combines pcie_clk payload state with core_clk status state in cfg_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
